conditionThreshold.filter: metric.type="run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count" AND resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name="__JOB_NAME__" AND metric.labels.result="failed"

documentation.content: The backup job __JOB_NAME__ ran and failed. The summary email from the same run lists which exports FAILED; details in `make logs JOB=backup`. A backup file without a .done marker is a partial: usable for salvage only.
